final.title: Pulling the Trigger: Final Quiz
intro: This isn’t twenty multiple-choice questions. It ends with the first true start-to-finish trading session in the Academy: context, PIL, risk, size, daily capacity, entry, management and account control.
Sometimes there’s no entry. Sometimes a valid entry loses. Sometimes the right answer is to do nothing. The session is the test, not the number of trades. 80% to pass.

bank.prompt: Where does the 1M sit in the process?
Pre-entry card: everything defined except the PIL. Status?
Continuation candle strongly bullish, still open. Action?

Retest happened 3 candles ago, price is 20 points away.
+8, one bearish candle, nothing in the plan triggered.
Plan says trail after a new 1M HL. It forms. You trail.

asks.prompt: ENTER button pulsing, continuation forming. You…

bank.prompt: Describe your process from pre-trade to review in one paragraph.
bank.model: Context and PIL first, then risk and size from my cap, then wait for I · C · C closes and the first retest, follow the locked plan, update my daily risk, and stop when a limit is reached. Grade the process separately from the outcome.
